changelog: v1.3.0 - adds scripts/compare-runs.sh, side-by-side comparison of two self-improvement runs. Reads key fields from each run's run-info.md, baseline.md, proposal.md, validation.md, and outcome.md, prints a row-per-field table that flags divergences with a '*' marker, computes an aggregate verdict (identical/diverged) and an outcome_progression (same/improved/regressed/changed/n/a) so CI can branch on whether the second iteration actually improved on the first. Supports --json for dashboards. Exit 0 identical, 1 diverged, 2 on argument errors or missing artifacts. 9 end-to-end tests cover divergence detection, identical-run case, JSON shape, progression direction (improved/regressed/same), missing args, non-existent dir, partial-artifact dir, --help. No breaking changes - every v1.2.0 CLI flag and contract preserved.
summary: Evidence-based, approval-gated self-improvement workflow for OpenClaw. Use when the user asks to make OpenClaw or any project more reliable, faster, cheaper,...
